content: FlyBase is an online bioinformatics database dedicated to the biology and genome of the model organism Drosophila melanogaster and other related drosophilid dipterans. The FlyBase project is managed by a consortium of Drosophila researchers and computer scientists based at Harvard University and Indiana University in the United States, as well as the University of Cambridge in the United Kingdom. FlyBase is also one of the contributing organizations to the Generic Model Organism Database (GMOD) initiative. FlyBase provides a comprehensive and up-to-date repository of discoveries related to the Drosophila genome. It includes a searchable bibliography that spans a century of research on Drosophila genetics. Additionally, the database offers information on current researchers in the field and a partial pedigree of relationships among these researchers, which is accessible through the registration of participating scientists. The platform also hosts an extensive collection of images that visually represent the entire genome, as well as several videos that document the process of embryogenesis in Drosophila.
